merger_description:
Dolphin BidCo Pty Ltd (together with its connected entities, **Dolphin**), via the newly created entities of State Swim Mount Barker Pty Ltd, State Swim Norwood Pty Ltd, and State Swim Findon Pty Ltd, proposes to acquire the swim school businesses of Mt Barker Swimming School Pty Ltd, Norwood Swim School Pty Ltd, and Findon Swim School Pty Ltd, together with the associated intellectual property of Swim Plus Pty Ltd (collectively, the **Targets**).

Dolphin operates a number of swim schools in Western Australia, Victoria, South Australia (including six swimming schools across Greater Adelaide) and Singapore under the ‘State Swim’ brand.

The Targets operate 'Swim Plus' branded swimming schools in Mount Barker, Norwood, and Findon, in Greater Adelaide.

Both State Swim and Swim Plus branded swimming schools primarily offer swimming lessons to children between the ages of 6 months to 10 years.

determination_table_content.details:
State Swim Mount Barker Pty Ltd, State Swim Norwood Pty Ltd, and
State Swim Findon Pty Ltd (collectively, the Buyers), applied for a
notification waiver in respect of their proposed acquisition of the
swim school businesses of Mt Barker Swimming School Pty Ltd,
Norwood Swim School Pty Ltd, and Findon Swim School Pty Ltd,
together with the associated intellectual property of Swim Plus Pty
Ltd (collectively, the Targets), as described in the transaction
documents provided as part of the application (the Acquisition).

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

The Buyers are newly formed entities of Dolphin BidCo Pty Ltd
(together with its connected entities, Dolphin). Dolphin operates six
swimming schools across Greater Adelaide, and other swimming
schools in Western Australia, Victoria, and Singapore under the State
Swim brand. The State Swim swimming schools in Greater Adelaide
are located in Clovercrest, Glen Osmond, Golden Grove, Morphett
Road, Seaford, and Unley.
The Targets operate ‘Swim Plus’ branded swimming schools in
Mount Barker, Norwood, and Findon, in Greater Adelaide.
Both State Swim and Swim Plus swimming schools primarily offer
swimming lessons to children between the ages of 6 months to 10
years (learn-to-swim lessons).

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
certain publicly available information, and had regard to the factors
in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010
(Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information currently before it, the ACCC considers
that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material lessening
of competition. In particular:
a. there is a small geographic overlap between the parties in
the supply of learn-to-swim lessons on a local basis
b. there are alternative providers of learn-to-swim lessons in
the local areas surrounding each Swim Plus swimming
school and in Greater Adelaide more broadly.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s interim guidance on
notification waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
